title: Tenant VRF Reachability — VRF11 L3VNI Removed on dc1-leaf2a
symptom: VRF VRF11 inter-subnet routing failing. Type-5 routes present in RIB. Local host MAC/ARP resolved. Remote ARP incomplete.
root_cause: vxlan vrf VRF11 vni 11 removed from Vxlan1 on dc1-leaf2a. L3VNI is gone so VXLAN encap/decap for VRF11 fails at the dataplane.
fix_command:
interface Vxlan1
vxlan vrf VRF11 vni 11
